title: Russian Pan-Fried Dumplings
description: A classic Eastern European dish, Russian pan-fried dumplings are a hearty and comforting meal. This recipe uses a simple dough to wrap around a delicious filling.
instructions: 1. In a large pan, melt the butter over medium heat.
2. Add the dumplings to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
3. In a small bowl, mix together the beaten egg and bread crumbs.
4. Add the egg mixture to the pan and stir to combine with the dumplings.
5. Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the egg is set.
6. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
